summary: Part 4 of the 1.0 Onboarding App (KAM) video (11:58-15:24) covers the Revibe Seller Onboarding App. Pierre walks through a lead record (Leads, stage 'Sent to app'), then the Open applications and Processed applications views, explains each accepted-application sub-status from Access to create through Onboarded, then the KAM role, then one seller profile's Next steps message that the seller receives after approval, and closes by defining leads. All 20 frames (t00718 to t00923) were opened and the claims were checked against them. Several narration words are garbled and are flagged in asr_fixes and unclear. Counts on screen are a snapshot from recording.

Sub-status: the seller has been onboarded.

Profile status fields: Application status (e.g. 'Application closed') and Approval (Accepted or Rejected on the processed list; Incomplete or Final review on the open list). The video does not explain these further.

'the seller goes to access to create is accesses through for revive applications are created and the seller is assigned' is garbled. The order of Access to create, applications created and KAM assignment is not confirmed by the screen, so no timing is stated.
